name: 5-funkan no Maid
source:
“Where am I? Who am I!?”

Rim awoke in a stark, bare room.
She had no memory of who she was.

“Hey, Rim. What’s with the blank stare?”

Standing before her was a man claiming to be her brother, Shiba.
He said she was a maid nicknamed the “Ice Queen,” but she still had no recollection.

Before she could process his words, a fierce dizziness overwhelmed her.

“Huh? Where am I? Am I Rim?”

Same room.
Same man.
Same conversation.

Something was clearly wrong.

Rim realized she was trapped in an inexplicable loop.
A strange loop where she could carry over only “five” accumulated memories.

The closer she got to the truth, the more dangerous the situation became.
Could she escape this closed room?
What on earth is happening in the outside “world”?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4053760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我在哪儿？我是谁！？”

瑞姆在一间空荡荡的房间里醒来。
她不记得自己是谁。

“嘿，瑞姆。你那茫然的眼神是怎么回事？”

站在她面前的是一个自称是她哥哥斯波的男人。
他说她是一个绰号“冰雪女王”的女仆，但她仍然不记得。

还没等她反应过来，一阵剧烈的眩晕袭来。

“啊？我在哪儿？我是Rim吗？”

同一个房间。
同一个男人。
同样的对话。

显然出了什么问题。

瑞姆意识到她陷入了一个无法解释的循环之中。
这是一个奇怪的循环，她只能保留“五个”积累的记忆。

越接近真相，情况就越危险。
她能逃出这个封闭的房间吗？
外面的“世界”到底发生了什么？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4053760/]Steam[/url]]
